title: Quanta presentation tree
summary: Persisted Quanta version 2 default and bounded tree traversal used by Runtime. The quanta.tree Official tool owns graph patch rules; rendering goes to the isolated engine.

replaceability.why: The module holds Project integrity or trusted execution authority.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: walk
operations.notes: No local deadline is enforced. Input is root; output is depth-first tuples projected as arrays. Root is always group; a state has no children; content cannot nest inside content.

bounds.name: tree_depth
bounds.unit: exclusive depth ceiling, root is zero

invariants.text: Content nodes cannot nest inside content nodes, and state nodes cannot carry children.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: No replacement conformance runner exists for this seam.

known_deviations.text: Quanta graph writes are delegated to the Official package through document.tools; this traversal supplies no staged write or automatic layer fallback. The shared document commit still has separate file replacements.

quanta.description: Default version 2, theme {tokens: {}, mood: empty string, aspect: 16:9}, root {id: root, children: []}. Groups contain groups or content nodes; blocks marks a content node; its children are leaf states. Traversal validates bounded depth and node count, not every property.
